description: Predefined StudyBot questions with expected classifications and objectively checkable expectations. Used to spot genuine LLM failures when prompts or models change. 'history' holds earlier turns for follow-up questions. 'expected_tools' lists tools the tutor should call (empty = no tool required; out-of-scope = must be empty).
